title: Release Train

errors.noProject: Select a project to plan a release.

description: Plans the next version of every service of the project (npm, Python, .NET, Java, Kotlin, Go, Rust, Dart, PHP, Ruby, Elixir, Swift) from its commits, with the gates to pass.
noServices: No manifest with a name was found (package.json, pyproject.toml, .csproj, pom.xml, build.gradle, go.mod, Cargo.toml, pubspec.yaml, composer.json…).

train.title: Ship the services in order
train.hint: release-train.yaml says how each service deploys, rolls back and is checked. The train runs those commands wave after wave: the next service starts only once the previous one is healthy.
train.changedWhileApproving: The train file changed while you were reading it. Read it again, then approve.
train.noFile: Add release-train.yaml at the root of the project (or in .workpilot/). Each command is a list of arguments, never a shell line.
train.invalid: The train file cannot be used: {{error}}

approval.title: Approve this train file before it runs anything
approval.hint: {{path}} runs these commands on your computer. Read them. A change to the file (hash {{sha}}) will ask you again.
approval.variables: Project variables handed to the commands and flags: {{names}}

problems.cycle: The dependencies form a cycle ({{services}}): nothing can ship first. Removing the link from {{from}} to {{to}} would break it.
problems.unknownDependency: {{service}} depends on {{dependency}}, which the train file does not list: it is assumed to be in place.

start.productionHint: Production: each service waits for your click before its deploy runs.
start.stagingHint: Each service ships as soon as the previous one passed its checks. An external service waits for you to say it is ready.

notes.ai: Add a summary by the model
notes.byModel: Summary by the model, the list from the commits.

run.title: Train on {{environment}}
run.calendarWarning: A slot of {{service}} is planned on this environment now.
run.flagWaiting: Turn the flag {{key}} on in your tool, then confirm.
run.flagBlocked: The flag {{key}} could not be turned on: {{detail}}
run.blockedHint: Roll back takes the failed service and every shipped service that depends on it, dependents first; their flags go off before.
